explication: Wox is a native, cross-platform desktop launcher: a user opens it, enters a keyboard-first query, and receives results or actions from built-in and extensible plugins. The repository also contains substantial AI, file-search, settings, themes, and cloud-sync capabilities. The README documents the product workflow and plugin model; sampled source confirms plugin initialization and file-search indexing/storage, but much of the runtime wiring was not shown, so unverified connections are marked dashed.
